newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT slips 4.15 pct in mid-morning trade.
newsitem.headline: PLDT slips 4.15 pct in mid-morning trade.

text.p: Telecommunications giant Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) fell 60 pesos, or 4.15 percent, to 1,385 pesos in mid-morning trade on fears of a hefty cut in revenues, brokers said.

Harry Liu, president of Summit Securities Inc, said the reduction in income due to a pending reduction in international call rates led to a selloff in the stock. No timetable has been finalised for the rate reduction.

A Reuter poll showed that stockbrokerage houses have projected a 6.5 billion peso net income for PLDT in 1997, against the 5.2 billion peso expected net in 1996. But analysts said the proposed reduction in international rates had forced them to slash their previous forecasts for the year.
Liu said that near-term technical support has been pegged at 1,350 pesos. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
